title: HistoryResultStore is dead production code
existing_state: Services/HistoryResultStore.cs (89 lines, in-memory id→host-results/details maps) has zero production references — a repo-wide grep finds it used only by its own test file SSH_Helper.Tests/Services/HistoryResultStoreTests.cs. The per-run-file design in HistoryStorageService (payload files + index) replaced it entirely; Form1's history path goes through _historyStorage exclusively (Form1.cs:13009, 14240).
recommendation: Delete Services/HistoryResultStore.cs and SSH_Helper.Tests/Services/HistoryResultStoreTests.cs. Per the project's own 'no ghosts' rule, this is a leftover that misleads anyone exploring the history subsystem into thinking there is a second results cache.
user_benefit: No behavior change — removes 89 lines plus its test file that misdirect future history work and dilute the test suite's signal.

evidence.note: Class definition; repo-wide grep shows the only other references are in its test file
